sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Create a beautiful finished portrait 4:5 mobile puzzle clean plate, target1280x1600: a winding earthen meadow path bordered by mixed late-summer wildflowers, wide intimate view slightly above. Polished dimensional warm storybook digital painting, softly brushed natural textures, fine foliage and dusty path details, upper-left late-afternoon sunshine, no landmark, text, people, UI, border or watermark. Dominant cocoa brown and tawny tan: broad rich warm brown path fills lower center and curls toward distant brown grassy hills; dry golden-brown grasses occupy most of scene, with selective sage leaves and tiny mauve/cream flowers. Top fifth small warm pale blue sky with no distinct clouds yet. On upper-left show a slim tree trunk with a short bare side branch ending around x20%,y25%, no foreground leaf cluster there. Upper-right a separate small shrub with a thin bare branch ending x80%,y33%, without its foreground cluster. In lower-left soil around x16%,y84% reserve natural space for one delicate flower frond; at lower-right x82%,y87% reserve natural bare soil for a tuft of dry grass. Keep all surfaces fully painted, no holes or placeholder marks. Later parts will be autumn leaf twig, different sage shrub sprig, one wildflower stem, one golden grass tuft, and a wispy cloud. Paint scene naturally complete without those five foreground parts.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Production transparent PNG atlas of EXACTLY FIVE hand-painted sprite cutouts in a3-column by2-row grid; bottom-right cell entirely empty. Real alpha transparency, no background/backdrop, no checkerboard painted, no letters, borders or numbers. Each object well inside cell, at least60pixels transparent gutter around entire sprite. No sprite crosses cell midpoint or image edge. Dimensional softly brushed storybook illustration, warm sunlight upperleft, delicate tactile details, not vector or photo. Five distinct subtle details for a warm cocoa-brown late-summer meadow path: TOPLEFT a thin side twig carrying6small muted golden oakleaves, lowerleft bare stem tapers into a branch; TOPMIDDLE a graceful sagegreen shrub sprig with oval leaves, bare bottom stem; TOPRIGHT one slender wild chicory stem with2small dusty purple flowers and fine leaves, long bare bottom stem for rooting in earth; BOTTOMLEFT a small sparse tuft of warm dry golden meadowgrass with three feathery seedheads, narrow dark bottomroot; BOTTOMMIDDLE one faint elongated cream cloud wisp with beautifully feathered translucent edges. No soil, pots or ground. Each part unique and softly painted.
